normalIntro.en: Reliance is a lean on a rope: the word family is built on Latin religare, to bind fast.
normalIntro.cn: reliance 是靠在绳子上：整个词族建于拉丁语 religare（缚紧）之上。

normal.en: Rely is the verb, reliance is the noun, and reliable is the adjective.
normal.cn: rely 是动词，reliance 是名词，reliable 是形容词。

normal.en: The phrase reliance on is the standard frame: reliance on oil, reliance on others.
normal.cn: reliance on 是固定框架：对石油的依赖、对他人的依赖。

normal.en: Self-reliance, with the prefix self-, means standing on your own feet.
normal.cn: self-reliance 加了前缀 self-（自己），表示靠自己的双脚站立。

normal.en: The suffix -ance makes a noun from a verb, just as accept gives acceptance.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ance 把动词变成名词，正如 accept 变成 acceptance。

normal.en: Compare readable and reliable: both end in -able, and both say that something can be counted on.
normal.cn: 对比 readable 与 reliable：都以 -able 结尾，都表示「可以指望得上」。

abstract.en: Picture a climber whose whole weight hangs on a single rope.
abstract.cn: 想象一名登山者全身重量都挂在一根绳子上。

abstract.en: Imagine a table with one short leg, so the guests keep steadying it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张有一条短腿的桌子，客人们不得不一直扶着它。

abstract.en: See a row of dominoes leaning on the first one that fell.
abstract.cn: 看见一排多米诺骨牌都靠在那张第一个倒下的牌上。

examples.en: Heavy reliance on tourism made the town fragile in hard times.
examples.cn: 对旅游业的过度依赖使这个小镇在艰难时期很脆弱。

examples.en: Children need to learn some self-reliance before leaving home.
examples.cn: 孩子离家之前需要学会一些自立能力。

examples.en: Doctors warn against too much reliance on painkillers.
examples.cn: 医生警告不要过分依赖止痛药。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞来安身」——靠上好东西才安身，于是有了「依靠、信赖」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 religare（缚紧、重新系上）→ 古法语 relied（系在一起）→ 英语 rely → 加名词后缀 -ance 得 reliance，核心义「被系住并靠着」。religare 与 religio 的渊源有多种解释，此处只取「缚紧」这一条主线。

sensesIntro.en: Reliance begins with the physical act of leaning on something, and then extends to trust, to the person or thing leaned on, and to specialized uses in law, medicine, engineering, and society.
sensesIntro.cn: reliance 从「身体靠住某物」这一动作出发，再延伸到信赖、被依靠的人或物，以及法律、医学、工程和社会层面的专门用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: all your weight resting on one cord.
core.cn: 核心意象：全部重量压在一根绳子上。

branches.en: Depending on something for daily needs is the plainest use.
branches.cn: 为日常所需依靠某物是最朴素的一条。

branches.en: To depend on a thing from outside and to trust it from inside are two sides of one rope.
branches.cn: 从外部依赖它，与从内部信赖它，是同一根绳子的两面。

branches.en: The person leaned on becomes the reliance itself.
branches.cn: 被依靠的人本身就成了 reliance。

branches.en: Law, medicine, engineering, and machines each narrow the rope into a specific claim, condition, joint, or device.
branches.cn: 法律、医学、工程与机器各自把这条绳子收窄为具体的主张、病症、接点或设备。

branches.en: Single dependence and mutual dependence show one joint under stress and a whole net of them at rest.
branches.cn: 单一依赖与相互依存，一是受力的单个接点，一是静止时的整张网。

intro.en: Reliance is rely plus the noun suffix -ance, and the family keeps the same -able and -ly building blocks.
intro.cn: reliance 由 rely 加名词后缀 -ance 构成，词族里还用同样的后缀 -able 与 -ly 造词。

latinIntro.en: Latin religare, from re- back plus ligare to bind, supplies the image of a fast knot.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 religare 由 re-（回）加 ligare（系、缚）构成，提供了「打得紧紧的结」这一意象。

items.example: Re- marks a returning action in religare.
items.exampleCN: 在 religare 中，re- 表示往回的动作。

items.example: Ligare gives the binding image of the family.
items.exampleCN: ligare 提供这一词族「系缚」的意象。

items.example: Religare is the direct ancestor of rely.
items.exampleCN: religare 是 rely 的直接祖先。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或状态的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ance turns rely into reliance.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ance 把 rely 变成 reliance。

items.example: The suffix -able forms reliable.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 构成 reliable。

items.example: Un- reverses the meaning in unreliable.
items.exampleCN: un- 在 unreliable 中把含义反转。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms reliably.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 reliably。

items.example: Self- forms self-reliance.
items.exampleCN: self- 构成 self-reliance。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ity forms reliability.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ity 构成 reliability。

definition_zh: 搬迁；迁移；重新安置；调动到新地点
definition_en: to move a person, group, or business to a new place and settle it there
core_image: 把一株已经扎根的树连根挖起，运到新地点重新栽下
scene: 那家工厂把整条生产线迁到了海外，工人也随之搬迁。The company decided to relocate its factory overseas.
sceneCN: 这里 relocate 表示「搬迁」（第 3 个义项：企业、机构迁往新地点）；句意：公司决定把工厂迁往海外。

derivatives.zh: relocate 加名词后缀 -tion，义为「搬迁；重新安置」
relocate 加后缀 -able，义为「可迁动的；可重新定位的」
去前缀 re- 后的基础动词，义为「找出位置；设置于」
locate 的同源名词，义为「地点；位置」

senses.title: To move to a new place and settle
senses.definition: to move yourself or your family from one place to another and live there
senses.definitionCN: 把本人或家人从一个地方搬到另一个地方居住
senses.example: Many young graduates relocate to big cities for work.
senses.exampleCN: 许多年轻毕业生为了工作搬到城市。
senses.why: Latin locus is place and re- means again, so relocate is simply to place something again somewhere else.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 locus 是「地方」，re- 是「再」，所以 relocate 就是把某物重新安放到另一个地方。

senses.title: To move a person or group elsewhere
senses.definition: to move other people or a community to another place, often by instruction
senses.definitionCN: 把他人或某个群体移动到别处，常带指令意味
senses.example: Residents were relocated to safer ground.
senses.exampleCN: 居民们被重新安置到更安全的地方。
senses.why: The same re- and locus now act on other people, so the word gains a passive moved by someone sense.
senses.whyCN: 同样的 re- 与 locus 作用在别人身上，于是这个词带出「被别人挪走」的被动意味。

senses.title: To move a business or institution
senses.definition: to move the operations or the main office of a company, school, or agency
senses.definitionCN: 把公司、学校或机构的主要办公地点迁到别处
senses.example: The firm plans to relocate its headquarters next year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司计划明年迁走总部。
senses.why: A business is treated like a thing with one address: it is lifted from one site and placed at another.
senses.whyCN: 企业被当作只拥有一个地址的物体：整块从原址抬起，再放到另一个地址。

senses.title: To move something fixed to a new position
senses.titleCN: 把固定的东西挪到新位置
senses.definition: to take something that is fixed, such as a pipe or a sign, and fit it somewhere else
senses.definitionCN: 把管道、标牌之类固定安装的东西拆下并装到别处
senses.example: Engineers had to relocate the water pipe.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师不得不把水管改道。
senses.why: Here the place is measured in centimetres, so relocation is a change of position rather than of address.
senses.whyCN: 这里「地方」的尺度只有几厘米，于是搬迁变成改变位置，而不是更换地址。

senses.title: To move software or data
senses.definition: to move a program, file, or service from one system or server to another
senses.definitionCN: 把程序、文件或服务从一个系统或服务器移到另一个
senses.example: The team will relocate the database to the cloud.
senses.exampleCN: 团队会把数据库迁移到云端。
senses.why: Computing borrows the moving of physical goods: files stand in for crates and servers stand in for buildings.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域借用了搬动物品的意象：文件代替了货箱，服务器代替了楼宇。

senses.title: To move a plant or animal population
senses.definition: to move plants or animals to another habitat, or to help them shift range
senses.definitionCN: 把动植物移到另一个栖息地，或帮助它们转移分布范围
senses.example: Biologists relocate the elephants to avoid conflict.
senses.exampleCN: 生物学家迁移大象以避让人与象的冲突。
senses.why: With living things the re- also replaces the rooting of a plant, so the move carries a risk of failing to take root.
senses.whyCN: 对活物而言，re- 还要重新处理「扎根」的问题，所以迁移带着能否在新地成活的隐忧。

senses.title: To take up a job in another place
senses.definition: to accept a post in a different country or region and move there
senses.definitionCN: 接受另一国家或地区的职位并搬到那里
senses.example: She was relocating to Singapore for the new post.
senses.exampleCN: 她正为这份新职位搬到新加坡。
senses.why: When the place belongs to a job, relocation becomes the duty that comes with it, often on a company budget.
senses.whyCN: 当新地点由职位决定时，搬迁就成了随职位而来的义务，往往由公司出钱。

senses.title: To change the location of pain or a problem
senses.definition: to appear in a different place after being treated or after a shift of attention
senses.definitionCN: 经处理或注意力转移后，出现在不同的地方
senses.example: The ache in his back relocated to his shoulder.
senses.exampleCN: 他背部的疼痛转移到了肩上。
senses.why: The most abstract use keeps only the place shift, so a sensation can relocate without anything physically moving.
senses.whyCN: 最抽象的用法只保留「地点变了」，于是感觉也能搬迁，而没有任何物体真的移动。

intro.en: Relocate is an English-built word: the Latin prefix re- joins locus, place, through the verb locate, formed in the eighteenth century.
intro.cn: relocate 是英语自身的新造词：拉丁语前缀 re- 经十八世纪形成的动词 locate，接上 locus（地方）。

items.en: Locus means a place or a spot, and collocare means to place something together with another.
items.cn: locus 意为地方、位置，collocare 意为与另一物一同安放。

items.en: The idea of placing a thing in a definite spot spreads into law and church language.
items.cn: 「把某物安放在确定位置」的观念进入法律与教会用语。

items.en: Locate is formed from Latin locus in English, first meaning to set or place.
items.cn: locate 在英语中由拉丁语 locus 构成，最初意为「设置、安放」。

items.en: Relocate is formed by adding re-, again, to locate, at first mainly in American usage.
items.cn: relocate 在 locate 前加 re-（再次）构成，早期主要见于美式用法。

items.en: Business, computing, and wildlife management take up the word for their own moves.
items.cn: 企业管理、计算机与野生动物管理借用这个词来描述各自的「迁移」。

items.en: Today relocate covers moving homes, offices, data, and even a stage of pain.
items.cn: 如今 relocate 涵盖搬住处、迁办公室、迁移数据，甚至疼痛的转移。

note.en: Relocate shares the re- plus locate build with related words, and its nearest meanings are move, transfer, and migrate.
note.cn: relocate 由 re- 加 locate 构成，与相关词共享这一构词法，近义地位则与 move、transfer、migrate 相邻。

entries.definition: to find the position of something, or to place it
entries.definitionCN: 找到……的位置；设置于

entries.definition: the place where something is
entries.definitionCN: 地点；位置

entries.definition: the act of moving to a new place
entries.definitionCN: 搬迁；重新安置

entries.definition: to change position or go to another place
entries.definitionCN: 移动；搬家

entries.definition: to move someone or something from one place or job to another
entries.definitionCN: 转移；调动

entries.definition: to move regularly from one region to another
entries.definitionCN: 迁徙；移居

normalIntro.en: Relocate is re- again plus locate, to place: you take something and place it once more.
normalIntro.cn: relocate 就是 re-（再次）加 locate（安放）：把东西拿起来再放一次。

normal.en: Latin locus means place, and it also lives in local and location.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 locus 意思是「地方」，也活在 local 与 location 里。

normal.en: The prefix re- keeps its job here: it says again, so the place is set again.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 在这里守住本职：表示「再次」，地方被重新安置一次。

normal.en: The suffix -tion in relocation names the action, as in creation from create.
normal.cn: relocation 中的后缀 -tion 命名这个动作，如同 create 变 creation。

normal.en: Relocate is followed by to: relocate to a city, to another country.
normal.cn: relocate 常与 to 连用：relocate to a city（迁到某城）、relocate to another country（迁到他国）。

normal.en: Business writing prefers relocate for offices, where everyday speech would simply say move.
normal.cn: 商务写作中办公室用 relocate 更正式，日常口语则直接说 move。

abstract.en: Picture a potted tree being dug up and planted across the road.
abstract.cn: 想象一盆已经扎根的树被连根挖起，栽到了马路对面。

abstract.en: See a pin pushed into a new spot on a world map.
abstract.cn: 看见一枚图钉从世界地图的一处被拔起，按进了新的位置。

abstract.en: Think of a whole office packing its desks into boxes overnight.
abstract.cn: 想象整个办公室一夜之间把桌子装进箱子。

examples.en: The family relocated to a smaller flat near the school.
examples.cn: 这家人搬到了学校附近一套小一点的公寓。

examples.en: Local authorities relocated thousands of people before the flood.
examples.cn: 洪水来临前，当地政府重新安置了数千人。

examples.en: Relocation costs will be paid by the company.
examples.cn: 搬迁费用由公司支付。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞楼柯特」——瑞气搬进了新楼，于是 relocate 就是「搬迁、迁址」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 locus（地方）+ re-（再次）+ 动词后缀 -ate → locate（安放、定位）→ relocate（重新安放），核心义「把东西从原位抬起，再放到新位」。

sensesIntro.en: Relocate spreads from moving yourself, to moving others, to moving businesses, pipes, data, animals, and even a sensation of pain, each time narrowing what the place means.
sensesIntro.cn: relocate 从「自己搬家」扩展到「把别人挪走」，再到企业、管道、数据、动物乃至疼痛，每一次都在收窄「地方」的含义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rooted tree lifted and replanted elsewhere.
core.cn: 核心意象：一棵扎根的树被挖起，移栽到别处。

branches.en: Moving yourself is the everyday sense of the word.
branches.cn: 自己搬家是这个最日常的义项。

branches.en: Moving oneself and being moved by others share one verb but switch who holds the shovel.
branches.cn: 自己搬与被别人搬共用一个词，只是拿铲子的人换了。

branches.en: Businesses, data, and jobs each give the move a formal reason and an address.
branches.cn: 企业、数据与职位各自给这种迁移一个正式的理由和一个新地址。

branches.en: Pipes and plants are the most physical cases, so the word nearly turns back into move.
branches.cn: 管道与动植物是最物理的两种情形，词义几乎退回 move。

branches.en: Pain that changes place keeps only the shift and drops every carrier.
branches.cn: 疼痛的改变位置只留下「位移」本身，把所有载体都丢掉了。

intro.en: Relocate is built from the Latin prefix re- and the Latin place word locus, all passing through the verb locate.
intro.cn: relocate 由拉丁语前缀 re- 与表示「地方」的 locus 构成，中间经过动词 locate。

latinIntro.en: Latin locus means a place, and locare means to place; re- adds the idea of doing it again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 locus 意为地方，locare 意为安放；re- 补上「再做一次」的意思。

items.example: Re- says the placing is done once more.
items.exampleCN: re- 表示安放的动作再做一次。

items.example: Locus supplies the place in relocate.
items.exampleCN: locus 为 relocate 提供了「地方」。

items.example: Locare stands behind locate.
items.exampleCN: locare 是 locate 的祖形。

items.example: The suffix -ate forms the verb.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ate 构成动词。

items.example: The suffix -tion forms relocation.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -tion 构成 relocation。

items.example: The suffix -able forms relocatable.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 构成 relocatable。

items.example: Col- appears in collocate, to place together.
items.exampleCN: col- 出现在 collocate（放在一起）中。

items.example: The suffix -ion forms location.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ion 构成 location。

items.example: Dis- appears in dislocate, to put out of place.
items.exampleCN: dis- 出现在 dislocate（使脱位）中。

definition_zh: 剩余部分；余数；余下的时间；剩书；卖掉剩余作品
definition_en: the part of something that is left when the rest has gone or been used
core_image: 一整块布裁掉大部分之后，桌上剩下的那一角边料
scene: 他吃完披萨后把剩下的那几块装进盒子。He put the remainder of the pizza into a box.
sceneCN: 这里 remainder 表示「剩余部分」（第 1 个义项：用掉一部分后剩下的东西）；句意：他把剩下的披萨装进了盒子里。

pos.zh: 剩余部分；余数；余下的时间
把卖不掉的书降价处理

derivatives.zh: remainder 的原级动词，义为「留下；仍然是」
remain 的复数名词，义为「遗迹；残骸；剩余物」
remain 加 -ing 构成，义为「剩下的」
同源名词，义为「残余物；零头布」

senses.title: The part left over
senses.definition: the rest of something after some of it has been used, taken, or dealt with
senses.definitionCN: 某物被用掉、拿走或处理掉一部分之后所剩的部分
senses.example: She spent the remainder of the evening reading.
senses.exampleCN: 她把晚上余下的时间都用来看书了。
senses.why: The English suffix -er and the verb remain, to stay behind, give the plain image of a part that is still on the table.
senses.whyCN: 英语后缀 -er 加上动词 remain（留在原处），画面就是一部分东西仍留在桌上没被拿走。

senses.title: A holding of remaining stock
senses.definition: the unsold copies or goods left at the end of a season or print run
senses.definitionCN: 一个销售季或一版印数结束时尚未售出的商品
senses.example: The shop sold its remainder stock at half price.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店半价卖掉了尾货库存。
senses.why: When the leftovers belong to a shop, the abstract rest becomes a countable pile of goods in a back room.
senses.whyCN: 当剩下的东西属于一家商店时，抽象的「余」就变成后仓里一堆可以清点的货物。

senses.title: A remaindered book
senses.definition: a book that did not sell at full price and is now offered at a reduced one
senses.definitionCN: 未能按原价售出、如今降价出售的书
senses.example: He found the novel on the remainder shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 他在降价书架上找到了那本小说。
senses.why: Books are the classic leftovers, so the plural or attributive form means a whole trade in unsold copies.
senses.whyCN: 书是最典型的「余货」，因此这个词的复数或作定语时常指一门处理积压书的生意。

senses.title: The unused part of a period of time
senses.definition: the part of a day, a term, or a life still to come after now
senses.definitionCN: 从现在起，一天、任期或人生中尚未过完的部分
senses.example: Let us pause here and finish the remainder tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在这里暂停，余下的明天再完成。
senses.why: The image of cloth with a leftover corner transfers naturally to time, which is also cut into pieces.
senses.whyCN: 布裁完还剩一角的意象很自然地挪到时间上，因为时间也被切成一段一段。

senses.title: The number left in division
senses.definition: the amount left when one whole number is divided by another
senses.definitionCN: 一个整数被另一个整数整除后剩下的数
senses.example: Seventeen divided by five leaves a remainder of two.
senses.exampleCN: 十七除以五，余数是二。
senses.why: In counting, the leftovers are exact and countable, so remainder becomes a precise arithmetic term.
senses.whyCN: 在数数时，剩下的东西既精确又可数，于是 remainder 成为严格的算术术语。

senses.title: The part that is to be done later
senses.definition: the work or terms not yet finished or not yet discussed
senses.definitionCN: 尚未完成或尚未讨论的工作、条款
senses.example: The court will hear the remainder of the case in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 法院将在春季审理该案余下的部分。
senses.why: The same leftover part can be a piece of unfinished work, so the word can name what is still due.
senses.whyCN: 同一块「剩余」也可以是一段未完成的活儿，于是这个词能指还没有交办完的东西。

senses.title: The rest that stays behind in a place
senses.definition: the remains left by something that has gone, often in geology or archaeology
senses.definitionCN: 已消失之物留下的残迹，常用于地质与考古
senses.example: The remainder of the old bridge is now a ruin.
senses.exampleCN: 那座旧桥的残迹如今成了一处废墟。
senses.why: To remain can mean to stay in place, so remainder also names what stays behind when everything else is gone.
senses.whyCN: remain 本有「留在原处」之意，所以 remainder 也指其他东西都消失后仍留在原地的东西。

senses.title: To sell off leftover copies
senses.definition: to sell copies of a book or stock at a low price because they are no longer selling
senses.definitionCN: 因书或存货滞销而以低价卖出去
senses.example: The publisher remaindered the old edition.
senses.exampleCN: 出版社把旧版书降价处理了。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb when shops begin to act on the leftovers, so the word now means handling the rest.
senses.whyCN: 当店家开始对「余货」动手时，名词变成了动词，这个词就表示「处理剩下的东西」。

intro.en: Remainder is an English noun built on the verb remain, which came through Old French from the Latin verb remanere, to stay behind.
intro.cn: remainder 是建立在动词 remain 之上的英语名词，而 remain 经古法语来自拉丁语动词 remanere（留在后面）。

items.en: Remanere is re- back plus manere, to stay, so the root picture is someone who stays behind.
items.cn: remanere 由 re-（向后）加 manere（停留）构成，词根画面是一个留下来的人。

items.en: Remanere also describes things that are left over rather than carried away.
items.cn: remanere 也可描述没有被带走、因此还留下的东西。

items.en: Remaindre, to stay, carries both the person and the leftover thing into French.
items.cn: 古法语 remaindre（停留）把人留下与物余下两层含义一起带入法语。

items.en: English remain keeps the general sense of staying behind.
items.cn: 英语 remain 保留了「留在原处」的一般含义。

items.en: The noun remainder is built on remain with the French ending -er, naming the part that is left.
items.cn: 名词 remainder 以 remain 加法语式词尾 -er 构成，指留下的部分。

items.en: The book trade gives remainder the special senses of unsold copies and their reduced sale.
items.cn: 书籍行业给 remainder 增加了「滞销存书」与「降价处理」的专门含义。

note.en: Remainder belongs to the remain family and is easy to confuse with the word rest, so it is grouped with near meanings such as rest, remnant, and residue.
note.cn: remainder 属于 remain 词族，又与表示「其余」的普通词容易混，所以和 rest、remnant、residue 这类近义词归在一起。

entries.definition: to stay in a place or continue to be
entries.definitionCN: 留下；仍然是

entries.definition: still there when the rest has gone
entries.definitionCN: 剩下的

entries.definition: what is left of something, often ruins or parts of a body
entries.definitionCN: 遗迹；遗骸；剩余物

entries.definition: the part of something that is left
entries.definitionCN: 其余部分

entries.definition: a small piece left after the larger part is gone
entries.definitionCN: 残余物；零头布

entries.definition: what is left after a process or after liquid has gone
entries.definitionCN: 残留物；残渣

normalIntro.en: Remainder is remain plus -er: the thing that remains when the rest has gone.
normalIntro.cn: remainder 就是 remain 加 -er：其余的都走了之后仍留下来的那个东西。

normal.en: The verb remain means to stay, and the noun remainder is what stays behind.
normal.cn: 动词 remain 意为留下，名词 remainder 就是留下来的那部分。

normal.en: Keep the spelling of the ending in mind: rema plus inder, not remaimer.
normal.cn: 留意结尾拼写：应为 rema 加 inder，不要写成 remaimer。

normal.en: The -er ending names a thing, as in a container naming what contains.
normal.cn: 词尾 -er 用来指称一样东西，就像 container 指用来装东西的那件物品。

normal.en: In maths, remainder answers the question of what is left after division.
normal.cn: 在数学里，remainder 回答「除完还剩多少」。

normal.en: The book trade uses remainder as a noun and a verb for copies that did not sell.
normal.cn: 书籍行业用 remainder 作名词和动词，指没有卖出去的书。

abstract.en: Picture a cake with most of it eaten and one slice left on the plate.
abstract.cn: 想象一块蛋糕已被吃掉大半，盘子里只剩下一片。

abstract.en: See the last coins still in a bowl after everyone took their share.
abstract.cn: 看见大家分完之后，碗里还剩着几枚硬币。

abstract.en: Think of a shop assistant marking down books that nobody bought.
abstract.cn: 想象店员正在给无人问津的书贴降价标签。

examples.en: The remainder of the class went to the library.
examples.cn: 班上其余的人去了图书馆。

examples.en: Divide fifteen by four and the remainder is three.
examples.cn: 十五除以四，余数是三。

examples.en: Many of these titles were remaindered within a year.
examples.cn: 这些书中有很多在一年之内就被降价处理了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞门得」——好东西都散完了，只有靠着门才捡到剩下的那一份，于是记「剩余部分」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 manere（停留）+ re-（在后、留下）→ remanere（留在后面）→ 古法语 remaindre → 英语 remain → 加 -er 构成 remainder，核心义「留在原处、没被拿走的那一份」。

sensesIntro.en: Remainder starts from the plain idea of what is left, then narrows into business leftovers, books, time, arithmetic, legal work, ruins, and finally the verb of selling leftovers off.
sensesIntro.cn: remainder 从「剩下的东西」这一朴素概念出发，再收窄到商业尾货、积压书、剩余时间、算术余数、未了事务与残迹，最后变成处理尾货的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the corner of cloth left on the cutting table.
core.cn: 核心意象：裁完后留在剪裁桌上的那一角布料。

branches.en: The plain leftover is the everyday sense and the base of the whole cluster.
branches.cn: 普通的剩余部分是日常义项，也是整簇词义的根基。

branches.en: Goods, time, and tasks are all things that can be cut down, leaving a rest to finish.
branches.cn: 东西、时间与任务都能被切掉一部分，总有一块要留到最后完成。

branches.en: When the leftovers are in stock, the word moves into trade, both as goods and as a verb.
branches.cn: 当剩余物进了仓库，这个词就转进商业领域，既是货，也是动作。

branches.en: In arithmetic the leftover becomes exact, countable, and named by a symbol.
branches.cn: 在算术里，剩下的东西变得精确可数，还能用符号表示。

branches.en: To remain also means to stay in place, giving the sense of ruins left standing.
branches.cn: remain 还有「留在原处」之意，由此产生废墟尚存的义项。

intro.en: Remainder is remain plus the suffix -er, and the whole family grows from the Latin verb manere, to stay.
intro.cn: remainder 由 remain 加后缀 -er 构成，整个词族都长自拉丁语动词 manere（停留）。

latinIntro.en: Latin manere means to stay or remain, and re- adds the picture of staying behind after others leave.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 manere 意为停留，re- 补上「别人离开后仍留在后方」的画面。

items.example: Re- puts the staying behind.
items.exampleCN: re- 强调「留在后面」。

items.example: Manere supplies the staying.
items.exampleCN: manere 提供「停留」的核心义。

items.example: Remanere is the direct ancestor of remain.
items.exampleCN: remanere 是 remain 的直接祖先。

items.example: The suffix helps form similar nouns such as reluctance.
items.exampleCN: 这类后缀也帮助构成 reluctance 等同型名词。

items.example: The suffix -er turns remain into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 把 remain 变成名词。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms remaining.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 remaining。

items.meaningCN: 过去式或过去分词词尾
items.example: The suffix -ed forms remaindered.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ed 构成 remaindered。

items.example: Per- plus manere gives permanent.
items.exampleCN: per- 加 manere 构成 permanent。

items.example: In- plus manere gives immanent.
items.exampleCN: in- 加 manere 构成 immanent。
